title: Non-Hamiltonian $\frac{3}{2}$-Tough Plane Triangulations
summary: By Tutte's classic theorem of 1956 that every 4-connected planar graph is Hamiltonian, every planar graph of order at least three with toughness greater than $\frac{3}{2}$ is Hamiltonian. In 1999, Owens constructed a sequence of maximal planar graphs whose toughness approaches $\frac{3}{2}$ from below and which do not contain even a 2-factor, and he asked whether there exists a maximal planar graph with toughness exactly $\frac{3}{2}$ and with no 2-factor.
